messages:
Noah: kicking off slow-roll for ff.fast_exec on nomad-worker-v3 during tonight's 00:30 UTC change window. target is to minimize tail regressions.
Lina: ok please outline the safety gates. we'll want a pinned backroute and a quick abort cmd ready.
Noah: Ramp plan: 1% (smoke) -> 5% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. hold 8m at smoke, 12m at 5% and 15, 20m at 50. manual checks at each gate.
Maya: put an autoslack alert for p50/p95 jumps and error rate > 1% absolute. OpsBot: alert rule created: nomad-nwv3-fast_exec-safety.
DeployBot: queued: deploy nomad-worker-v3 (job: nwv3-20260401-07) to eu-west-1. ETA ~4m.
Noah: safety details: pin old-route-eu to handle quick rollback. if p95 > baseline + 100ms for 10m OR 5xx% > baseline*1.8 then pin+disable flag.
Lina: also limit concurrent tokens for cohorts: cohort token cap = 50 for 5% and 15% steps.
Diego: will enable function-level tracing for the 5% cohort only. logging command ready:
```
# run once on tracing svc
tracing.enable --scope="ff.fast_exec:cohort-5pct" --duration=2h
```
Noah: DeployBot: releasebot will toggle ff.fast_exec per step. commands to abort: `/deploy abort nwv3-20260401-07` and to pin: `/routes pin old-route-eu --reason "fast_exec safety"`.
Maya: DocsBot, attach one-liner for oncall and link to rollback playbook.
DocsBot: https://redwood.internal/docs/deploys/nwv3-fast_exec - includes rollback playbook and operator commands.
DeployBot: toggle 1% -> SUCCESS at 1798123380. ff.fast_exec = 1%
Lina: saw a +0.8% error wobble but then stabilized. holding smoke 8m complete.
Noah: moving to 5% now. enabling token cap.
DeployBot: toggle 5% -> SUCCESS at 1798123420. observability: https://observability.redwood/nomad/nwv3?range=15m
Diego: traces show a small sub-second tail increase on specific shard, instrumenting a metric for that shard.
Maya: remind partners: cost watch enabled. if cost delta > 15% in next hour, mention @eng-cost.
Noah: stepping to 15% in 12m unless we hit rollback criteria.
DeployBot: toggle 15% -> SUCCESS at 1798123470. ff.fast_exec = 15%
Lina: p95 +60ms at 15% on eu-west-1 but still under threshold. continue.
Noah: proceeding to 50% after 20m soak. keeping enhanced traces for 1h post-50%.
Maya: if any region shows more than 10% of 5xxs concentrated, we should drain that region's workers and pin route. OpsBot: region drain playbook staged.
DeployBot: toggle 50% -> SUCCESS at 1798123505. ff.fast_exec = 50%
Noah: team, hold. we'll observe metrics for 20m then finish to 100% if stable. final finish should be quick.
Lina: great coordination, thanks. posting a short debrief in #release-notes after finish. :white_check_mark:
